ref_noise.how: vLLM `guidance` (0.26.1rc1.dev602+g65b7662d3, the build the golden records, fp8 KV cache, prefix caching on) re-scored the exact ids of the stored golden (`tools/golden_vllm.py --ids-from`, `scripts/cuda-round7/vllm-self.sh`); KL21(stored golden || re-run) by `scripts/m3-accuracy/setkl.py` (`scripts/cuda-round7/kl-table.sh`): both sides truncated to top-20, a reference id missing from the re-run's top-20 gets the re-run's 20th probability, the scored value drops the ChatML system and user-turn rows. M3 measured two more re-runs: 2.37e-2 and 2.66e-2 on all rows, 8.6e-3 and 8.7e-3 on the scored rows (docs/results/2026-10-21-m3-accuracy-debt.md 2.4). The all-rows value is dominated by chat_reuse_4k (0.118), the prompt vLLM itself does not reproduce. `prompts` holds the per-prompt all-rows values of that same re-run, copied from the log (user decision 2026-10-21 13:58); M3's other re-runs put chat_reuse_4k at 0.129, 0.151 and 0.102 (docs/results/2026-10-21-m3-accuracy-debt/raw/vllm/setkl.txt), so one re-run's per-prompt value moves by about 1.3x either way. Per-prompt scored-rows values of the vLLM re-run are in no committed log and are not recorded.
